flags.title: 8 of 15 High picks price shorter than −250
flags.detail: A 70% probability prices at −233 American and the brief's window starts at −250, so only 70.00%–71.43% fits both rules. Where the match winner is stronger, the desk publishes the deepest line it originates that does fit — and where no originated line fits, it publishes the winner at its true price with this label rather than shortening it to look compliant.
flags.missing: A window that starts at −233, or acceptance of out-of-window High labels

flags.title: Five High picks per sport is not reachable in every sport on this snapshot
flags.detail: Priced sports with fewer than five High labels: Baseball 0, Handball 4, Rugby League 0, Rugby Union 1, Tennis 0. Ice Hockey, Basketball and Handball reach five, four and four respectively; Baseball, Tennis and Rugby League have no fixture whose strongest in-window selection clears 70%. The nine sports with no price at all are covered individually below.

flags.detail: The official WST match feed carries the draw, but each player has only two or three completed matches in the captured window. A five-match minimum is applied before any frame model is published, so every snooker fixture is listed without a price.

flags.title: 13 OLBG cricket listings are unpublished
flags.detail: ICC, NZC, CSA and ECB fixture endpoints return 403/404 in this snapshot and the ICC rankings pages are client-rendered. Without an official per-team input the internationals and the Australian and South African domestic one-day matches cannot be priced.

flags.title: 9 OLBG darts listings are unpublished
flags.detail: pdc.tv serves a 1.2 MB client-rendered shell for every tournament path tried, and the WDF calendar carries tournament dates but no match scoring. No 180s, checkout or leg data exists to build a price from.

flags.title: 11 OLBG greyhound races are unpublished
flags.detail: GBGB publishes results (readable, and captured) but the racecard endpoints answer 404, so no forward race, trap draw or recent sectional time can be confirmed.

flags.title: 22 OLBG volleyball listings are unpublished
flags.detail: The PlusLiga table page is a round-by-round archive whose rows reach 30 played matches in October, so it cannot be tied to the 2026-27 fixtures; the Italian SuperLega table is current but only one round has been played.
flags.missing: A current-season PlusLiga table, or several rounds of SuperLega results

flags.title: The F1 and MotoGP races are listed but not priced
flags.detail: Both calendars publish dates and venues only. No lap-time, grid or points model can be built from them, and the driver-order page used in earlier builds carries finishing order without pace.

flags.title: No Gaelic fixture could be listed at all
flags.detail: The GAA fixtures page is a Next.js shell with no fixture payload, the GAA API path is a 404 and the provincial pages publish no readable fixture list. The OLBG Gaelic hub returned zero events in this capture, so there is not even a listing to publish.
flags.missing: A GAA fixture feed and a populated OLBG Gaelic hub

flags.title: Golf has no listing and no readable field
flags.detail: The OLBG golf hub returned zero events and the OWGR ranking page is a client-rendered shell, so neither an outright nor a tournament matchup can be originated.
flags.missing: An OWGR snapshot with values, or a published tournament field

flags.title: Nine priced rows, no High label
flags.detail: Every RLWC 2026 side has one completed match in the official feed. The model shrinks those rates hard toward the tournament mean, which caps confidence at Low; the listed tournament prices are shown only as a cross-check and are never used as an input.

flags.title: No NBA rows: the NBA CDN answers 403 to this runner
flags.detail: Basketball coverage is EuroLeague and EuroCup only. cdn.nba.com returns 403 for both the schedule and the scoreboard endpoints, and stats.nba.com is not reachable, so the NBA slate is left out rather than approximated.

flags.title: Three competitions publish local times
flags.detail: SHL (Swedish), Top 14 (French) and PlusLiga (Polish) publish venue-local kick-offs; the stored UTC value is the converted time and the row records the conversion. The French and Polish clocks change on 25 October, so rows on either side of that date use different offsets.
